purpose: Teach: 奴ら/巷/傍ら/導き/綴っ/無けれ/しかり/情景

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「あの奴ら」って表現をやめてくれって仰ったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer asked us to stop using that slang word. We should listen to them.
lines.style: Gently informative, not accusatory. Soft certainty. Pauses slightly before the ask—giving Aoi space to understand without judgment. Warm corrective.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、巷の流行を取り入れたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I know. I want to keep up with what people are into, but you're right.
lines.style: Accepting, slightly sheepish. A quick breath in before speaking—acknowledging the fair point. Not defensive. Genuine openness to the guidance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様を傍らに本を読まれてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And that customer was reading a book with their child right next to them. It was such a calm moment.
lines.style: Warm, almost wistful. Noticing the small grace in it. Soft mid-sentence pause—savoring the image. Voice descends gently at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新スタッフの導きを丁寧にしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's make sure we're taking care with how we guide the new staff too.
lines.style: Steady, clarifying. Not harsh—building on the moment. Clean attack on the opening phrase. Measured pace. The tone of someone setting a quiet standard.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご感想を綴って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of the customers even left us a note about how much they appreciated the place.
lines.style: Pleased warmth. Light lift on "left us a note." Eyes-lit quality. Sharing something genuinely good without overselling it. Lets the fact land simply.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、笑顔が無ければ良いお店にならないわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That's what makes a shop feel right—when everyone's smiling and actually meaning it.
lines.style: Reflective certainty. Not preachy. A quiet conviction underneath. Slight emphasis on "actually meaning it." The tone of someone who knows what matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様への気遣いもしかり、徹底しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: And we should keep that same care with every customer, not just the ones who say something nice.
lines.style: Gentle but firm. The "and" opens into deeper ground. Thoughtful pace. Not scolding—inviting her to see the fullness of it. Quiet integrity underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の暖かい情景を写真に残そうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's try to capture those warm moments in photos sometimes. Keep them close.
lines.style: Soft closing warmth. Hopeful lift. Invitation rather than instruction. Slight trailing-off on "keep them close"—letting the sentiment linger. The voice of someone building something real.
